title: 1.5.0 release umbrella - the H3 cut on the 1.4.x line, a deviation from the 2.0 roadmap
description:
UMBRELLA for the 1.5.0 release. 1.5.0 IS NOT A MASTER CUT - it is a deliberate deviation from the 2.0 roadmap, branched from the last released tag. Master stays on the road to 2.0 with Flows as its headline. Read this sentence before answering any question about this release; assuming a master cut is what made this argument reopen five separate times, and it is now written into ~/.claude/projects/C--AI-Mpi-Cubric-Vision/memory/project_release_model_github_only.md.

WHERE THE WORK LIVES: branch `1.4.2`, worktree C:/AI/Mpi/Cubric-Vision-1.4.x. v1.4.2, v1.4.3 and v1.4.4 are all tagged on that line. Master is a SUPERSET of it - all four hotfix cards (MPI-673/674/675/685) have commits on master too, so nothing needs back-merging.

SCOPE, as Fabio set it: the MiniMax H3 speed/quality work, the ComfyUI 0.31 -> 0.34 engine bump, a set of small user-visible fixes, and (added 2026-09-07) the non-Flow image-model work including Klein 9B. NOT Flows, NOT Music Maker, NOT 3D scene - those are 2.0.

THE LOW TIER IS OUT (Fabio, 2026-09-06) and the NVFP4 text encoder is DROPPED (Fabio, 2026-09-07) - its R2 object is deleted and MPI-698 is closed `rejected`.

Members are tracked in plan.md, not as separate cards: the ports already landed, the ports still to do, and the four gates left (notes, smoke, stamp, release). checklist.md is the tick list. Handoffs continue against THIS card until 1.5.0 ships.
